summary.text: The nature Gu refinement technique is a hairy man refinement method that borrows dao marks of heaven and earth to assist Gu refinement.

claims.text: Fang Yuan later places hairy man nature Gu refinement among the two historical styles of refinement path: it uses nature and dao marks to refine Gu, while human isolation style stands opposite it.
Yu Mu Chun teaches this method as the hairy man return to refining Gu in nature, set against human techniques that seek a quiet environment isolated from the outside world.

When refining Gu, the refiner should be surrounded by nature, because the world holds an endless number of dao marks. Making use of those dao marks means the world itself helps refine Gu. Yu Mu Chun chooses suitable ground through astrology and earth veins, then uses hidden dao marks in heaven and earth as that assistance. He reports a forty percent success rate on rank six Immortal Gu and a five percent success rate on rank seven Immortal Gu once his technique reaches great success. Learning it demands huge amounts of time and resources.

Yu Mu Chun warns Ben Duo Yi that the inheritance can be studied, but a Gu Master who is not yet a Gu Immortal cannot use the method to refine Gu, because it attracts heavenly tribulations and earthly calamities. Yu Mu Chun leaves the refinement path inheritance to Ben Duo Yi for that study.
He later combines the method with a success dao mark from the Infallible inheritance when refining a rule path Immortal Gu, and treats that pairing as enough to make success certain.

Lang Ya land spirit states that it inherited its main body’s special hairy man nature Gu refinement technique, which uses dao marks of heaven and earth to assist refinement. Calamities and tribulations occur, but the advantages surpass the disadvantages. It teaches Fang Yuan secrets of that technique, including Gu refinement methods and mortal killer moves for refinement work. Fang Yuan judges that if the method works, it would be far superior to the human isolation style.
Later, when he is not undergoing tribulation and is not using the hairy man nature Gu refinement technique to refine Immortal Gu, heaven’s will cannot act on him through that route.

When cleanse soul Immortal Gu refinements keep failing, he notes that hairy man Gu Immortals specialize in the nature Gu refinement technique, and that he uses human isolation style instead to keep heaven’s will from interfering.
Four Elements Square Regret Blood Refinement Pool merges the essence of human style Gu refinement and hairy man nature Gu refinement, cutting Immortal Gu refinement cost and raising success rate.

The killer move lingering poisonous ant plague contains refinement path profundity and stands at the apex of the current world’s hairy man nature Gu refinement technique. That technique uses natural dao marks of the outside world to refine Gu and raise success rate. When Fang Yuan creates the move, his attainment in the nature Gu refinement technique already surpasses Long Hair Ancestor in every aspect.
